newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's OSROK says buys 5,383 tonnes aluminium.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's OSROK says buys 5,383 tonnes aluminium.

text.p: South Korea's Office of Supply (OSROK) said on Wednesday it bought 5,383 tonnes of aluminium through a tender.
An OSROK official said it had initially invited tenders for 6,383 tonnes, but did say why a smaller purchase was made.
LG Metals Corp sold 2,570 tonnes for delivery to the Inchon warehouse and 2,135 tonnes to the Pusan warehouse.
Hanhwa Corp sold 503 tonnes for delivery to the Taegu warehouse and 175 tonnes to the Kwangju warehouse.
The official said the aluminium must be high-grade primary ingots of London Metal Exchange-registered brand.
